AvenMain.title: TECH COMPANY #3
AvenMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #3
to renovate a house.
AvenMain.rewardText: Well done! There are {{actorCounts.AvenHouse - 1}} other houses to find on the islands. Renovate them to unlock more glorb Points.

BrigitMain.title: TECH COMPANY #1
BrigitMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #1
and participate in a
bike race.
BrigitMain.rewardText: Congratulations! Come back anytime and finish your lap in less than {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}} seconds to unlock more glorb Points.

PomeloMain.title: TECH COMPANY #8
PomeloMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #8
to build the bridge.
PomeloMain.rewardText: Nice! Keep your eyes open, there are chests on the island, next to the house.

ZendaMain.title: TECH COMPANY #9
ZendaMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #9,
and aid someone in pain.
ZendaMain.rewardText: So nice! There is {{actorCounts.CitizenSick - 1}} other people that need assistance on the islands. Help them and you'll be rewarded with more glorb Points!

BrigitSide.rewardText: Complete the bike race in under {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}}s.
